source_inspection_notes: Read tx_origin.py in full: TxOrigin._contains_incorrect_tx_origin_use only flags tx.origin read inside a CONDITIONAL node (if/require/assert) AND only when msg.sender is NOT also read in the same node (an explicit anti-false-positive carve-out for msg.sender==tx.origin patterns). EthTrust's requirement prohibits tx.origin's mere presence anywhere, unconditionally -- a tx.origin read used non-conditionally (e.g. logged in an event, or used in arithmetic) would violate EthTrust's text but never trigger this detector.

derivation_trace.analyzer_behavior: Flags tx.origin only when read inside if/require/assert AND msg.sender isn't also read there.
covered_cases: tx.origin used in an authorization conditional -- the highest-risk case, and covered
uncovered_cases: tx.origin read in any non-conditional context (logging, arithmetic, non-auth branches) -- violates EthTrust's unconditional text but never flagged
derivation_trace.final_classification: PARTIAL_MATCH -- evidence collector for the auth-relevant subset; full coverage needs a broader 'any read of solidity variable tx.origin' custom predicate reusing Slither's own `solidity_variables_read` without the conditional-node/msg.sender carve-outs.

analyzer_version: slither-analyzer==0.11.5 (pip-resolvable via importlib.metadata in this repo's .venv)
